screen.name: Title Recording
screen.purpose: Record up to 12 seconds and transcribe it into the task title.

excludes: capture warm-up before the first sample

behavior.onApply: Stop capture and send the recording through the existing speech-to-text flow. Write the transcript into the task title.
behavior.onLimit: At 12 seconds of capture, stop and transcribe the same way as Apply.
behavior.onCancel: Discard the recording. Do not transcribe. Leave the title unchanged.
behavior.audioRetention: The recording is temporary. Do not save it as an audio attachment.
behavior.transcription: Automatic after Apply or after the 12 second limit. There is no separate Transcribe action.

starting.description: The screen is open and capture has not started. The ring stays empty and the counter stays at 0 / 12 s.

recording.description: Capture is in progress. The ring and the counter follow elapsed capture time, not the time since the screen opened.

stopping.description: Capture has stopped because of Apply or the 12 second limit. The ring and counter hold. Actions are unavailable.

transcribing.description: The captured audio is being transcribed. The title is not updated until the transcript arrives. A second recording cannot start.

error.description: Microphone permission failed, capture failed, or transcription failed. The title is unchanged. The user can close the screen and try again.

visualRules: Use the voiceRecorder component from design-system.json.
Do not define screen-specific colors, radii or spacing.
The reference PNG is a visual target for composition and density, not a source of token values.
Do not reproduce the glowing halo or the color-cycling ring from the reference. The ring is the thin accent stroke from voiceRecorder.
Do not show a waveform, a pause control or a saved-audio state.
Keep the header, microphone and actions as one compact group. Do not leave a large empty field between the microphone and the actions.
12 seconds, the counter format and automatic transcription belong to this screen. Do not copy them into design-system.json or into the audio attachment recorder.

reference.description: Approved composition reference for the 12 second title recorder. The halo in the image is superseded by the thin ring in voiceRecorder.

angular.note: Opened from the title microphone on Create Task and Edit Task. Reuse the existing voice recorder and speech-to-text flow. Do not create a second recorder implementation.
